subject: English
question_text: Write a summary of the passage in no more than 90 to
guide_solution: Summary Florence Nightingale was born in Italy. She was a devoted Christian. She decided to serve the sick. That's why she became a nurse. She was given her first post to organize a small hospital in London which was an institution for the care of sick gentle women in distressed circumstances. She went with a mission to serve the wounded solders in the war. She worked very hard to bring order and cleanliness to the hospitals. She used to move around the hospital and enquired of the soldiers regarding their sufferings. Thus she became a heroine to the British soldiers.  অনুবাদ(Passage No. 2) : 171 a little bit increase. The graph shows that population did not increase much in 2010 form the year of 2009. In 2012, there was only 1% increase which was 1.58%. According to the graph, we can say that the lowest population growth rate was in 2009 and the highest was in 2005. In 2009, the rate was only 1.29% but we see that by three years population growth jumped into 1.58%. In 2010, there was a very quick increase of population from 1.58% to 1.55%. Within next three years, the population growth did not increase.
